issue.title: chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 3.14.1 to 4.1.0 in superset-frontend
issue.body:
Problem: `superset-frontend/package.json` pins `js-yaml@3.14.1`, which is flagged by `npm audit` for prototype pollution (GHSA-8j8c-7jfh-h6hx). The 3.x line is unmaintained.

Expected outcome: `js-yaml` is upgraded to `4.1.0` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, the two call sites in `superset-frontend/src/utils/yaml.ts` use the 4.x `load`/`dump` API (the 4.x release removed `safeLoad`), and `npm audit` no longer reports the advisory.

Validation: `npm ci && npm audit --audit-level=high` reports no js-yaml advisory and `npm run test -- yaml` passes.

Reference: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#400
